supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'Bitcoin resilience tested as U.S. dollar climbs to 18-month high'
CNBC: Treasury yields at multiyear highs, Fed minutes this week
CoinDesk: Traders pricing out October rate cuts despite Bitcoin ETF inflows
investment_theses.counter_view: Institutional BTC accumulation (Metaplanet +1,000 BTC, Bitcoin ETF inflows three weeks running) suggests conviction despite dollar strength; DXY may remain elevated if Fed holds rates longer.
investment_theses.expression: Short DXY futures via CBOT or FX options (6-month put spread); or long BTC/USD pair trade (long BTC, hedge with short USD via currency forwards)

investment_theses.thesis: Airline capacity cuts and elevated fuel costs will support airfare inflation through Q3 2026; delta airlines/airline sector ETF (IYT) upside is underpriced vs. ticket price risk.
